name: Sonic / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. Three separated strong sound-pressure pulses and a broad metallic resonant ring sweeping downward, with a wavering harmonic decay. No electrical fizz. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
